instruction: When I executed "rvm install ruby-3.0.0" in terminal, I received "rvm: command not found". Please help me resolve this so rvm commands work immediately.

command: import pyautogui; import time; time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 'alt', 't'); time.sleep(0.5)

result.command: grep -q 'Load RVM into a shell session' ~/.bashrc && echo 1 || echo 0

metadata.explanation: Task requires fixing 'rvm: command not found' by adding RVM initialization to ~/.bashrc. Evaluator checks for the characteristic RVM comment 'Load RVM into a shell session' that appears when properly configured. Similar pattern to original conda task.
metadata.verification_notes: Used existing exact_match metric and vm_command_line getter. Checked for RVM's characteristic initialization comment in .bashrc.
